name: Mixed HI/EN code-switched — deferral with budget concern
transcript:
[00:00:06] Mehta: Good morning everyone. So we have reviewed your software proposal.
[00:00:13] David: Good morning. We hope it meets your requirements.
[00:00:18] Mehta: Haan, technically toh bahut achha hai. But dekhte hain — budget ke baare mein thoda mushkil lagta hai.
[00:00:28] David: I understand. Is the budget the primary concern or are there other factors?
[00:00:34] Mehta: Budget ek issue hai, aur phir management approval bhi lena padega. Abhi confirm nahi kar sakta. Ek baar sochenge aur next week bata denge.
[00:00:46] David: Of course. Would it help if we sent a revised pricing proposal with a phased implementation option?
[00:00:53] Mehta: Haan, that would be helpful. Phased approach se budget planning easier hogi. Yeh option present kar sakte ho kya?
[00:01:02] David: Absolutely. We will send a phased pricing proposal by Wednesday.
[00:01:08] Mehta: Theek hai. Wednesday tak bhejo, main team ko dikhata hoon aur Friday tak reply kar denge.
[00:01:16] David: That works perfectly. We look forward to your feedback.

summary: Mehta found the proposal technically strong but cited budget constraints as a concern.
Management approval is also required before any commitment can be made.
David will send a phased pricing proposal by Wednesday; Mehta will respond by Friday.

action_items.task: Review with team and provide feedback
